coverageNotes: Native fixture engine C72A077938C26096EBF5452F29E597BA62B219B00C78F3A7D5F2E0A38678292C differs from frozen real-media engine 5a69574fa91fff7b03945999cbd10ad794c8da6c13a64e19f412420348c4e048; both use pinned CPU f445a7d289cf6545c46731a0d94e59e7c8c56b189a0c43768f4009874c0cb6f2.
Correctness replays only; no throughput acceptance measurement.
No ROM, media, build output or credential committed; no package publication.
Real replays use native input/media events only. Diagnostic traces read RAM/registers without injecting game state.

The original disk-A swap at 75100 preceded CopperStart menu completion. At 102400 the game keyboard peek examined queued disk-change messages and rejected them; healthy input tasks continued posting raw keys. Final replay delays A until 120100 instead of filtering documented disk IDCMP events.
Retained Lotus 3 scene timing differs from the earlier ROM; scene checks are correctness smoke coverage, not historical golden equality or throughput acceptance.
sourceChanges: Guest Classic Intuition resident: screens, flat full-screen borderless windows, text, pointers, raw key/mouse/disk IDCMP.
Actual console Screen/Window via ACTION_DISK_INFO; active Intuition window owns physical keyboard.
Generic native DOS library loader; non-AUTOINIT TRUE return resolves registered rt_Name; original diskfont and five fonts load from media.
Draw/ClipBlit/ClearScreen and compact raster/bitmap/display emitters adapted from primary CopperStart WIP; AllocRaster failure NULL.
IRQ Signal wakeups defer context switch to outer user return; internal task/list transaction masks interrupts and preserves direct INTENA ownership and Enable semantics.
Disable/Forbid defer rescheduling; Wait saves and restores per-task nesting and breaks it while another task or idle runs. GetMsg uses real completion/scheduling bridge.
Native DF0 physical change queries; DOS volume remount by name/creation stamp, offline identity retained and track cache invalidated.
Detached public UserPorts remain caller-owned; no IORequest mn_Length legitimacy filter.

Native graphics ReadPixel consumes public WORD coordinates, returns the combined planar pen independently of write mask/drawing mode, and retains its documented -1 coordinate-bounds result. Missing vector observed at first fault120486.
remainingScope: One PAL OCS viewport: 320 depth1-6 or640 depth1-4, height<=256.
Positioned/bordered windows, gadgets, menus, general Layers, interlace, multiple visible viewports and equal-priority timer slicing remain unqualified.
Full campaign completion, saves and audio fidelity remain unqualified.
